examples: Name studio when spawning a browser-heavy task and watch it run from studio's copy of the repository while its report lands on your board.
Let two computers work the same project in parallel, each agent in its own folder, with one board and one chat at home.
Refresh every replica computer after a change lands.
how_to: Ask the project agent to call swarm_spawn with machine set to the computer's name (the project must have that computer as a replica).
Turn auto-distribute on in the Pack settings to let placement choose a computer on its own; off, every spawn stays home.
POST /api/v1/pack/refresh with the project to carry its latest commits to its replicas.
media_exempt: Routes and agent tools only in this slice; the machine badge ships in its own change.
name: Pack span
summary: a project's agents run on several paired computers from the same repository: the home keeps the board, chat and memory, and a remote agent's Swarm and chat tool calls are run by the home as its own action after it checks the call really came from that computer's own agent.
where: Agent tools (swarm_spawn machine) and the Pack API.
